claim: MobileNetV1 uses a per-input-channel depthwise spatial filter followed by 1x1 pointwise channel mixing
notes: Depthwise alone never mixes input channels

claim: The cost ratio is 1/N + 1/k^2 for equal output spatial shape
locator: Section 3.1, Equations 2 and 5, ratio following Equation 5
notes: Counts MACs; no claim of identical hardware latency

claim: MobileNetV1 uses BN and ReLU after its DW/PW convs; first convolution is conventional
In original V1 architecture 1x1 pointwise conv accounts for 94.86% Mult-Adds and 74.59% parameters
Width multiplier alpha reduces channels and resolution multiplier rho reduces spatial area
notes: Quadratic alpha effect approximate because depthwise term linear

claim: Original 1.0 MobileNet-224 gives ImageNet 70.6% accuracy, 569M Mult-Adds, 4.2M parameters
notes: Original paper ImageNet classification; not modern retraining

claim: Full conv variant is 71.7% 4866M 29.3M; 0.75 MobileNet-224 is 68.4% 325M 2.6M
A narrower V1 0.75 224 variant beat shallower V1 at roughly matched MACs
V2 uses inverted residuals and linear bottlenecks with shortcut between narrow features when shapes permit
notes: V2 not original V1; ReLU6 in expansion/depthwise

claim: V3 combines hardware-aware NAS, NetAdapt, SE, and h-swish
V4 introduces universal inverted bottleneck and Mobile MQA for multiple mobile accelerators
